lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mn3FeN crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 20 atoms (Mn12Fe4N4) distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe and Mn centers each coordinated by four N neighbors, with Fe–N distances of 1.921–2.104 Å and Mn–N distances of 1.921–2.119 Å. The N centers are octahedrally coordinated by four Fe and two Mn neighbors, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner- and edge-sharing between N-centered octahedra and between Fe- and Mn-centered four-vertex polyhedra.
